title: Polynomial circuit complexity of the halting language
statement: The universal halting language belongs to polynomial size: there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ and a family of Boolean directed acyclic circuits, one for each input length $n$, that computes this language, has well-formed gates of fan-in at most two, and has size at most $a(n+1)^k$ for every $n$.
